title: Prewrite Critique
excerpt: B"H Boruch Hashem Blessed is He Prewrite Critique The Awtsmoos asks one last time whether the vessel leaks, duplicates, or slows; Awtsmoos.com answers by separating discovery families and indexing only what public truth already shows. Thirty final improvements/checks 1. Work from fresh origin/main, not stale shared HEA
searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he prewrite critique the awtsmoos asks one last time whether the vessel leaks, duplicates, or slows; awtsmoos.com answers by separating discovery families and indexing only what public truth already shows. thirty final improvements/checks 1. work from fresh origin/main, not stale shared head. 2. do not stage .ai thoughts. 3. preserve current road ssr exactly. 4. put new specific comment/translation routes before generic post routes. 5. return noindex for missing comments/translations. 6. escape comment html and urls. 7. preserve line breaks as paragraphs, never trust comment html fields as markup. 8. index audio transcript text when present. 9. index structured comment section text. 10. link comment author to real alias route only when alias id exists. 11. link comments back to canonical parent teaching. 12. render replies on comment pages with canonical links. 13. keep parent preview bounded. 14. let comment sitemap carry depth beyond preview. 15. ignore deleted native pointers. 16. alias sitemap uses real public alias registry, not imported attribution ids. 17. alias profile missing → noindex page. 18. alias canonical encoding must be stable. 19. app catalog filters duplicate game category cards. 20. deduplicate app/game urls before sitemap generation. 21. keep only same origin public urls in generated sitemaps. 22. generated html must escape catalog prose. 23. translation pages use public translation reader, not internal summary records. 24. translation sitemap derives from actual imported post files. 25. root sitemap index stays under protocol limits. 26. core sitemap contains only stable hubs. 27. tests assert catalog freshness against registries. 28. tests assert sitemap family references. 29. raw runtime tests verify ssr, noindex, and real data. 30. deploy exact tested sha and verify every family publicly.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he release manifest blocker and public proof the awtsmoos opened the public roads before the release court finished its final song; awtsmoos.com is serving the site wide seo, yet the verifier exposed a manifest vessel that remained two runtime paths wrong. observed public proof production activation printed canonical server sha 22b97234166d223369a9284ade3534c80eb421a9. raw origin http after activation returns http 200 for robots, root sitemap, alias sitemap, translations catalog, apps catalog, games catalog, and the ikar road. root sitemap contains comment and translation sitemap families. apps, games, and translations expose the semantic catalog marker. the road exposes the server rendered initial article and no longer contains the earlier $$sd template error. release verifier blocker verifytunnelpublicrelease.mjs rejected the release because the committed tunnel manifest.txt omitted: lib/connection vessel/child runtime state.js lib/connection vessel/controller child liveness policy.js both source files exist. the shared canonical working tree currently has a local modified manifest containing the two paths, but neither head nor origin/main contains them. that local modification must not be claimed or overwritten. repair strategy 1. create a clean worktree from latest origin/main. 2. run the repository's own manifest generator there. 3. verify the generated manifest differs only as legitimately required by current runtime inventory. 4. run manifest freshness, release closure, tunnel release, and public release verifier tests. 5. commit only the reproducible manifest/release artifact changes. 6. push with a fresh main race check. 7. fast forward the clean activation vessel and rerun guarded production activation until it exits zero. 8. re verify the public seo graph and then continue the post live shadow work audit.
